review.proportion: Walk head volume/crown and body baseline normalized against measured idle anatomy, preserving the original 32 gait poses. See walk-registration.json for before/after bounds.
review.cleanup: Chroma specks removed; connected pale edge halos still need manual cleanup.
review.alignment: Scholar authored per-frame placements share cell anchor; original hand pixels restored as body-front. Vest width and side/back registration need art refinement.
review.paperDoll: Idle and walk share both costume designs and hair scale. Dedicated directional walk gait and clothing twist remain independent.
review.idle: Dedicated eight-direction standing body and garments. Four breathing/hem/hair deformation frames with bit-identical lower-body pixels. Both hair styles and staff use shared designs with idle-only registrations. All combinations remain prototype pending human approval of proportions, grip closure and transitions.
review.grip: Dedicated closed right-hand artwork registered to both actions; foreground fingers occlude the shaft. Detailed wrist/shaft contact and all-direction anatomical approval remain prototype review.
